body.content: Developed an RL-based adversarial filter using PPO to prevent Mistral-7B from responding to LLM jailbreaks. Fine-tuned RoBERTa for embedding extraction and trained an XGBoost regression head to predict harmfulness scores (0.15 MAE). Utilized scores as reward signals for RL-based safety mechanisms.

Created a C++ event-based system to replay historical tick data for testing execution strategies; implemented strategy hooks and latency-aware replay engine with multi-threaded architecture to profile system performance to simulate real market constraints

Designed a mid-frequency predictive modeling pipeline based on alternative credit to forecast next-day asset returns; generated next-day alpha signals and simulated cumulative generated PnL over time.

Designed and implemented a multi-threaded trading simulation engine with order lifecycle management, position reconciliation, and event-driven strategy replay. Core components include - broker service, position manager, strategy engine, simulation framework. Validated system reliability through Monte Carlo simulations of 1k+ concurrent orders.

Developed a 3D visualization tool for IV surfaces in Python that allows Black-Scholes calculations for configurable set of parameters to identify pricing inefficiencies. Projected the slices of the 3D surface onto the Wasserstein manifold and used optimal transport to gain deeper insights into volatility shifts. Developed a high-performance server to periodically capture and store the implied volatility surface of configurable option tickers. Implemented the server using Python (Asyncio) for asynchronous tasks and PostgreSQL for efficient time-series data storage. Deployed the system on Docker.

Invitational competition where we worked on analyzing datasets in groups. The purpose of the project was to analyze how various energy-related variables, such as fossil fuel consumption and renewable energy production, impact socioeconomic indicators like unemployment and personal income across different U.S. states. My contributions focused on exploratory data analysis (EDA) and feature engineering, including the ideation process of model development such as Random Forest and Lasso Regression. We also trained an LSTM neural network to forecast crude oil prices, achieving a 0.89 R², and provided valuable insights into how oil prices might evolve in the near future. Our team won the 1st place.

This project is a version of proxy-worker architecture I set up for my internship at Omega Therapeutics to simulate dynamic load balancing of servers. The core flow is as follows: Proxy routes Client requests -> Backend worker processess using Omega's internal RPC over sockets. This mini infra-structure resembles the one I built during the internship.

Created a novel data imputation approach for drug-target interaction matrices by integrating matrix factorization with weighted random walk score propagation on a human protein-protein interactome. Developed and validated the model using k-fold CV, leveraging neural network property predictors and augmenting datasets with random-walk-imputed interactomes. Reduced RMSE by 18.8%, achieving consistent molecular optimization success rates; voted best project in class.

Designed Variational AutoEncoders (VAEs) to extract low-dimensional representations of mutation, gene expression, and molecular fingerprints, reducing reliance on large labeled datasets and hand-engineered features. Integrated the Junction Tree VAE for molecule representation learning. Built a supervised deep neural network model to predict drug sensitivity (IC50) by combining the encoded features. Leveraged public datasets including CCLE and GDSC for model training and evaluation, achieving improved performance (R² = 0.81) over traditional models.

Developed a novel LSTM-based model for seizure prediction using multichannel EEG recordings from human data, achieving an AUC-ROC of 0.91. Engineered a feature extraction pipeline focusing on time-based interpretable metrics (average, standard deviation, power, activity) across 21 EEG channels, enabling clinician-friendly interpretation.
